_doc: Waivers + baseline for the automated a11y suite. Mirrors scripts/contrast/allowlist.json. Refresh baselines with the per-script --print-baseline flag.

rules._doc: Per-rule waivers for the rendered axe sweep. Set 'waived: true' to suppress an entire rule globally. Use sparingly — prefer per-selector waivers below.

region.reason: Marketing pages legitimately use multiple top-level wrappers (hero + main + footer). Re-evaluate when we land a single-<main> refactor.

axeNodeSelectors.reason: Radix internals; not authored by us.

ariaBaseline._doc: Pre-existing axe violations at suite introduction. Refresh with: PREVIEW_URL=... node scripts/a11y/check-aria.mjs --print-baseline

staticAriaBaseline._doc: Pre-existing static a11y findings. Refresh with: node scripts/a11y/check-static-aria.mjs --print-baseline

keyboardBaseline._doc: Pre-existing keyboard / focus-order findings. Refresh with: PREVIEW_URL=... node scripts/a11y/check-keyboard.mjs --print-baseline

keyboardRouteWaivers._doc: Per-route selector waivers for the keyboard probe (e.g., skip-to-content links that intentionally appear out of visual order).
